title: Exclude WorkIQ feature key from demo data feature enablement
summary: The WorkIQ feature key is now excluded from automatic enablement in demo data setup, requiring explicit admin opt-in through Feature Management instead.
key_points: WorkIQ feature added to ExcludeNewFeature lists in demo data creation codeunits
Applied consistently across W1, CZ, and IN layers plus Contoso demo dataset
WorkIQ remains a platform feature requiring explicit admin configuration
Prevents unintended automatic enablement for data access functionality
Aligns with security-sensitive features like PowerAutomateCopilot and FullTextSearch
